item.title: Seed Of Life Leather Bracelet
item.description: Brown Seed of Life leather cuff bracelet worn on the wrist. A beautiful laser engraved leather bracelet featuring other the seed of life and flower of life. For wrists up to 22cm in diameter. Designed by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Cyber Serpent Belt
item.description: Cyber Serpent leather belt rolled up, showing the engraved psychedelic serpent pattern. A high quality leather belt featuring intricate laser engraved psychedelic patterns inspired by the twisting form of a futuristic serpent. Organic curves, geometric details and hypnotic shapes flow around the belt, creating a bold design that feels part ancient creature, part cybernetic organism. Designed by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Flower Of Life Belt
item.description: Brown Flower of Life laser engraved leather belt with silver buckle. A high quality leather belt featuring an intricate Flower of Life pattern, flowing continuously around the entire belt. Overlapping circles evolve into complex geometric forms, creating a mesmerising pattern that feels both organic and precise. Designed by 1000 Errors.
